title: MASTERMIND node
description: The universal envelope. Every node in the lattice is one of these regardless of what produced it — speech, import, a module, or a model. Shared header, typed payload, exactly like the vault envelope: the parts that must be inspectable without opening the contents live on the outside.

id.description: UUID. Stable for the life of the node; edges reference it.

type.description: What KIND of thing this is. 'gap' is a segment of speech that could not be transcribed — recorded rather than dropped, so the sequence has no unexplained hole.

spokenAt.description: When it was SAID, which is not when it was processed. Imported backlogs depend on this being the real time.

provenance.description: Who made this. REQUIRED on every node (DR-003). A system for externalising one mind that quietly fills with another's has failed at its purpose, and the only defence is that every node can name its author a year later.

model.description: Which model, when author is 'model'. Null is invalid for model-authored nodes.

timeTrusted.description: False when the timestamp came from file mtime, which changes on copy or sync.

requestId.description: Links a model-authored node back to the exact assist request that produced it.

mode.description: Which compartment produced it. Present from node one because it cannot be retrofitted: a node born in the sandbox must not be weighed like an observation, and unlabelled history is unlabelled forever.

confidence.description: Only for nodes that make a claim. Omit rather than defaulting — a confidence number nobody set is a fiction.

basis.description: Why this level. A level with no basis is not evidence.

history.description: Prior levels with their basis. A belief that never records its updates is a log, not a belief system.

horizonId.description: Set when a seed has been promoted into horizon planning.

seq.description: Capture-time sequence. Ordering is assigned when spoken, not when transcribed.

payload.description: Type-specific body. The envelope stays fixed; this varies.
